assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area polygons are PROVISIONAL (derived from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson, official_boundary=false). They are usable only for scheme generation, self-check, visualization and design discussion, not as official redline, approval basis, precise-area basis or statutory control. All area/ratio metrics, drawings and HTML are provisional and must be recomputed when official geometry is supplied.
assumptions.impact: Content scoring is not blocked by this data gap, but every metric and map carries provisional precision and must be recomputed against the official redline before any professional or statutory use.
